rows.quantity: log-log slope of F_5%/B vs B
rows.reference_source: Weibull weakest-link asymptote 1/k = 0.1667, averaged over 3 seeds (nested, N=2000). The B/L = 1..10 finite-range constant is the expected residual; the per-seed exponents are reported, not the best one

weakest-link: min over a wider window cannot exceed the narrower-window min, so with nested (common random number) windows F_5%/B must fall realisation by realisation -- a structural identity, not a fit

rows.quantity: monotonicity violations without nesting (sampling noise reference)
rows.reference_source: independent seeds per width at N=500: the 5 % quantile is the ~25th order statistic, so a few pointwise inversions are expected noise

rows.quantity: channel-solver wrapper F_5%/B vs the module's own ensemble (N=50)
rows.reference_source: same generator with N=50 instead of 2000: the 5 % quantile of N=50 is the ~2.5th order statistic, so ~10-30 % scatter is expected, not a defect

rows.quantity: declared mean flexural strength vs Timco & Weeks (2010) first-year ice band 1.0-2.5 MPa
rows.reference_source: Timco & Weeks (2010) table: first-year ice flexural strength ~0.6-3.4 MPa, median ~1.5 MPa; 0.54 MPa is the repository default (declared calibration input, not fitted here) and sits BELOW the band -- honest note
